name: vmware-aiops
description: Turn VM lifecycle requests into explicit, auditable operations for vCenter and ESXi.
long_description: Runs the published vmware-aiops 2.5.2 MCP server locally. This extension starts with read-only tools (expose = read); set it to all to offer VM lifecycle and deployment tools, which stay governed by the shared policy and are recorded in the local audit log. Run `vmware-aiops init` once to write the config file and local credentials, then point this extension at that config.

config_path.title: vmware-aiops config file
config_path.description: config.yaml written by `vmware-aiops init`. Passwords stay in the .env file next to it.

expose.title: Tools to offer
expose.description: read = read-only tools only (default); all = every tool, including VM lifecycle writes.
